responses.draft_cover_letter:
I am excited about the Java Developer role on Meridian Insurance’s claims platform team, where my proven experience delivering microservices and robust REST APIs can contribute immediately. In my recent work I built Node.js‑based microservices that powered a parcel‑tracking system, and I designed and implemented RESTful services using Python’s FastAPI framework, demonstrating a strong grasp of service‑oriented architecture and API design.

My responsibilities also included owning the PostgreSQL data model for those services, ensuring data integrity, performance tuning, and seamless schema evolution. This background equips me to handle the relational data needs of the claims platform and to collaborate effectively with database administrators.

While my recent projects have focused on JavaScript and Python, I am eager to transition those skills to Java 17+, Spring Boot, and the associated build tools such as Maven and Gradle. I have a track record of quickly mastering new languages and frameworks, and I am confident I can become productive with Oracle and Jenkins pipelines through focused learning and hands‑on practice.

I look forward to discussing how my microservice expertise, API development experience, and commitment to rapid skill acquisition can support Meridian Insurance’s mission to modernize its claims processing. Thank you for considering my application.
